title: Finite closed cover cohomology vanishing
statement: Let X be a Noetherian topological space, let q be a nonnegative integer, and let S be a finite collection of closed subsets whose union is X. If H^q(Z,G) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is zero for every Z in S and every abelian sheaf G on Z with its subspace topology, then H^q(X,F) is zero for every abelian sheaf F on X.

proof.text: Induct on S before requiring it to cover X, proving universal vanishing on its closed union S.sup id. For S empty the union is empty; apply [lem-sc-empty-space-cohomology-vanishing].

For insert Z S, the induction hypothesis gives universal vanishing on S.sup id. The original hypothesis gives universal vanishing on Z. Since the new union is Z sup S.sup id, apply [lem-sc-closed-union-cohomology-vanishing].
Rewrite S.sup id as top by hcover. Apply [lem-sc-whole-closed-subtype-cohomology-vanishing] to obtain the conclusion for F on X.

lean.statement:
theorem cohomology_vanishing_of_finite_closed_cover
    (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [NoetherianSpace X]
    (S : Finset (Closeds X)) (hcover : S.sup id = ⊤) (q : ℕ)
    (hvanish : ∀ Z ∈ S,
      ∀ G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Z : Set X)) AddCommGrpCat.{u},
        IsZero (Sheaf.H' G q (⊤ : Opens (Z : Set X))))
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    IsZero (Sheaf.H' F q (⊤ : Opens X))
